# Best Open Source Grok Bot Alternatives

By Suraj·Reviewed ·Verified

Grok Bot is xAI's agentic product, not the Grok chatbot. You set up bots once, each with its own memory and history like a teammate with a name, all working on one shared cloud computer with a browser, a filesystem and a terminal. Maybe you saw that it needs a paid Cursor or SuperGrok plan with no free tier and wondered whether a self-hosted stack can do the same work. Eight projects get close, and I ranked them by how much of that setup they keep. Some give every bot its own machine, some live in Slack or Telegram, and a couple keep an audit trail behind a policy gate. [...] Is Grok Bot the same as the Grok chatbot?

No. Grok Bot and the Grok chatbot are two different products from xAI. Grok is the conversational AI on grok.com and in the X app. Grok Bot, at x.ai/bot, is an agentic product: bots you set up once, each with its own memory and history, that share a persistent cloud computer with a browser, a filesystem, and a terminal, and that keep running multi-step tasks even when your device is off. xAI also offers Grok Build, a separate coding CLI agent, which is a different product again.
